data.subject: decision-alerts
data.ask: Which track should Decision alerts take?
data.why: New feature with a new notifier component across the CLI and tracker, and channel and event choices that need a PRD

data.subject: decision-alerts
data.ask: Q1 Channel: where should a decision alert appear?
data.why: macOS desktop alerts reach you away from the terminal and browser with no server running; browser alerts work only while the cockpit tab is open
data.costOfWaiting: DA-01.1 and DA-01.2 wait; browser or both adds a browser feature

data.subject: decision-alerts
data.ask: Q2 Events: which events should send an alert?
data.why: Stale approvals, late updates and decisions older than 2 working days are only found when gates are read, so they need a timed check, and timed reminders are a non-goal

data.subject: decision-alerts
data.ask: Q3 Limits: one alert per decision with macOS Focus, or our own rate limit and quiet hours?
data.why: You already control Focus; decisions per hour is UNKNOWN, so our own limit needs numbers only you can give

data.subject: decision-alerts
data.ask: Q4 Systems: macOS only, or also Linux and Windows?
data.why: The agents run on your Mac; Linux and Windows support is UNKNOWN. Other systems send nothing and never fail the command

data.subject: decision-alerts
data.ask: Q5 Record: where should each sent alert be recorded?
data.why: An alert is a fact about one Mac; the committed event log is shared history every clone merges, and test runs would add to it. Cost: the coverage metric is measurable only on your Mac
data.costOfWaiting: DA-04.1, DA-04.2 and the first success metric wait

data.subject: decision-alerts
data.ask: The QA testability check cannot run before the PRD gate (spawn guard EN-10.1 needs a build-ready task). How should we proceed?
data.why: Each of the 17 criteria already has a written test note; QA maps every criterion to a test at the QA stage anyway. Fixing devolps is a separate change in another repo
data.costOfWaiting: The PRD gate request waits; nothing else is blocked

data.subject: decision-alerts
data.ask: Who adds the line /.project-notify/ to the root .gitignore? No role can write .gitignore today.
data.why: devops-sre already owns repository config (package.json, tsconfig.json), and T1 must merge first anyway. Only you edit .claude/.
options: devops-sre adds it in task T1; you add .gitignore to devops-sre's write scope in .claude/harness.json
You add the line by hand in the T1 pull request
Drop the root line; rely only on the folder's own .gitignore that the CLI writes
data.recommendation: devops-sre adds it in task T1; you add .gitignore to devops-sre's write scope in .claude/harness.json
data.costOfWaiting: T1 and T2 cannot be built as designed until this is answered; the design gate is not blocked.
